notes.title: Hacker's Beat Update!!
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

We have some great news for you today. Hacker's Beat has now gone through a major update!

We have added an Edit mode in Hacker's Beat as well as some new songs!! 

Enjoy Hacker's Beat with 2 songs from [url=http://playism-games.com/publishing/en/sub/croixleur.html]Croixleur Sigma.[/url]
And a new song from [url=http://playism.jp/game/183/rakugaki-ninja]Doodle Ninja![/url] (←Sorry Japanese Link!)

You can now add and create your own challenges and levels. 

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/blogpostextras/hackers+beat+edit+1.jpg]

To join in on the fun of making your own level, head over to the edit mode and select a song that is under 3 minutes long! 

Then you can place different types of keys using your mouse or play the song and type to input where you want keys. 

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/blogpostextras/hackers+beat+edit+2.jpg]

With the new edit mode, you can control just how hard or difficult you want your song to be. Kick up the bpm or lower it down for different experiences with different songs of your choice. 

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/blogpostextras/hackers+beat+edit+3.jpg]

Once you have completed your level, make sure you save it! Then head over to play mode and select your song! 

For more information, make sure you check the [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/363650/manuals/Hacker'sBeat_editmode_manual_EN.pdf?t=1466153475]manual![/url]

Are you ready to [strike]rock[/strike] hack?
